description: Shrink images for page speed: resize to max_width (never enlarging), compress to WebP (or keep the type with format "original") and step down toward the 200 KB large_images limit without visible loss. Returns a private download link (48 h) per image, sizes before and after, and a paste-ready tag. Billing: 1¢ per 5 images optimized (rounded up per call); free when an image saves under 10 KB or 10%, when an image CDN already serves WebP/AVIF under 200 KB (served_optimized), for errors and skipped files, and for a repeat within 24h. 300 images an hour per workspace. When to call: after get_crawl_issue(large_images): site_id or domain optimizes the latest crawl's images over 200 KB, largest first; or urls for any public image. Returns: { items: [{ url, status: optimized|optimized_still_over_limit|already_optimized|skipped|failed|not_processed, reason?, before, after, saved_bytes, saved_pct, download_url?, filename, expires_at, snippet?, references_to_update, billed, repeat_free? }], totals, charged_cents, next_offset?, note, next_step }. Follow next_step, then submit_urls and crawl_site to confirm. SVG and animated images are skipped; past 45 s, unfinished images come back not_processed (free).

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

format.description: webp or original (keep the type and file name). Default webp; original on WordPress and for next/image or i0.wp.com sources.

limit.description: With site_id: images per call. Default 10, max 20.

max_width.description: Widest output in pixels, 320–3840. Default 1920. Never enlarges; to reach 200 KB it may narrow, never under 1280 px.

offset.description: With site_id: default 0. Use next_offset from the previous answer.

quality.description: Starting lossy quality, 40–95. Default: the preset (75 for photos).

run_id.description: With site_id / domain: the crawl run. Default: the latest scored crawl.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites (or domain): optimizes its latest crawl's large_images, largest first.

urls.description: 1–20 public image URLs. Use this or site_id.

name: optimize_image
title: Optimize images: resize and compress to WebP, with download links
